backend/main.mo: Backend actor handling user profiles with access control and a lead capture system including CRUD operations for leads.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking WhatsApp CTA updates to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of multiple frontend files used for reference in build planning.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based CSS defining light and dark theme design tokens using OKLCH values.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component wiring global providers, page sections, and floating action buttons.
frontend/src/components/admin/Commercial: Admin panel for creating, updating, and deleting commercial projects with modal-based form handling.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Authentication button managing Internet Identity login/logout state with React Query cache reset.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal prompting users to enter their name and save their profile using backend integration.
frontend/src/components/commercial/Comme: Displays a commercial project card with title, location, details, highlights, and a WhatsApp contact button.
frontend/src/components/FloatingCallButt: Floating call button linking to a predefined telephone number using CONTACT_CONFIG.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: Floating WhatsApp button opening a clean wa.me link via generateWhatsAppLink.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteFoote: Renders the site footer with branding, service areas, property types, contact info, and a powered-by link.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteHeade: Provides the site header with branding, login, call button, and consultation trigger.
frontend/src/components/properties/Prope: Shows a property card with image placeholder, key details, ROI badge, and a WhatsApp inquiry CTA.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: Displays an about section with company highlights and descriptive content from COPY.
frontend/src/components/sections/Feature: Fetches and displays commercial projects, shows admin panel when applicable, and handles loading and empty states.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: Renders the hero section with headline, subheadline, description, and CTA buttons for investments and consultation.
frontend/src/components/sections/Investo: Interactive ROI calculator that computes annual returns from property price and monthly rent inputs and displays results with styled UI.
frontend/src/components/sections/LeadCap: Lead capture form with validation, submission via API, and a success state screen after sending inquiry details.
frontend/src/components/sections/Testimo: Empty component file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/sections/WhyInve: Displays reasons to invest in Pune using a predefined list of benefits with icons and descriptions.
frontend/src/config/contact.ts: Centralized config storing contact details including phone numbers, email, and location.
frontend/src/config/whatsapp.ts: Provides WhatsApp link generation utilities using configured phone number and optional custom messages.
frontend/src/content/copy.ts: Centralized static copy for UI text across hero, forms, properties, admin, and footer sections.
frontend/src/data/properties.ts: Deprecated property type definitions and empty demo data retained only for reference.
frontend/src/data/testimonials.ts: Empty file reserved for testimonial data.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages authenticated or anonymous backend actors and refreshes dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminStatus.ts: Checks whether the current actor is an admin using a backend call and exposes admin status state.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommercialProjects: CRUD hooks for commercial projects using actor API, with react-query integration and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks to manage Internet Identity login state and AuthClient creation, exposing identity, login, logout, and status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines a React Query mutation hook for submitting lead data via the backend actor and invalidates the leads query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfile.ts: Provides hooks to fetch and update the current user's profile using React Query with actor-based backend calls.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for light/dark themes, typography, and global styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, persisting, and clearing URL parameters and session-stored values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with theme extensions, color variables, animations, typography, and plugins.
project_state.json: Stores project configuration, requirements, issues, and architectural notes for the PKC Urban Capital website.
